body:
graph: skip the LM head for pooled embeddings ( #30445 )

- graph: skip the LM head for pooled embeddings

A context that extracts pooled embeddings outputs one vector per

sequence, but every model still expanded its LM head, so the graph

computed n_vocab logits per token and the context kept a host buffer

The models now only declare t_logits, and set_outputs() expands it

unless the context extracts embeddings with a pooling type other than

NONE. Since the toggle changes the graph shape for a pooled context,

set_embeddings() schedules a re-reserve in that case.

- graph: drop the redundant t_embd expand

Address review from @CISC : with embeddings on, build_pooling() already

expands its output for every pooling type, and a decoder graph without

embeddings does not read t_embd, so set_outputs() only expands

- graph: add build_logits() for the LM head output

Address review from @ggerganov : the LM head is expanded by a dedicated

build_logits(), called from llama_model::build_graph() like

build_pooling(), and set_outputs() only marks the outputs again.

- graph: call build_logits() before build_sampling()

Address review from @ggerganov : build_sampling() reads t_logits, so the

LM head is built first. A pooled context then skips the sampling layers

too, since it has no logits to sample from.

summaryZh: llama.cpp发布b11597版本，优化了嵌入提取流程。当上下文提取池化嵌入时，计算图将跳过LM head的展开与词表logits计算，避免此前为每个token计算词表logits并维护主机缓冲区的资源浪费。同时重构了build_logits与build_sampling调用逻辑。

aiReview.reasonZh: llama.cpp在提取池化嵌入时跳过LM head计算，显著节省显存与算力。
